heroHeadline: Ukraine Strikes Ilsky Refinery in Krasnodar, Widening Southern Russia Fuel Campaign
heroSubtitle: The Ilsky oil refinery in Krasnodar Krai was struck Sept 26, a target distinct from Perm and Novoshakhtinsk hit in preceding days — extending Ukraine's drone reach deeper into southern Russia's refining network
